description: The benchmarks' map data: OpenFreeMap's OpenMapTiles vector tiles of central San Francisco (street, and street-mlt as MLT), of the whole world to zoom 4 (world) and of central Tokyo (cjk), and Mapterhorn's terrain tiles of central San Francisco (terrain), each a PMTiles archive; OpenFreeMap's Liberty style pointed at them, with its sprite and the glyph ranges the tiles' labels need; Noto Sans font files; and as GeoJSON, Natural Earth's countries and the USGS's earthquakes of October 2026. tools/bench-snapshot built it.

sources.origin: OpenFreeMap's planet build https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet/20261115_080022_pt, in the OpenMapTiles schema; street-mlt holds the street tiles re-encoded as MLT
sources.license: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, under the Open Database License 1.0 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). OpenMapTiles' schema and design are under CC BY 4.0 (https://github.com/openmaptiles/openmaptiles/blob/master/LICENSE.md).

sources.origin: OpenFreeMap's Liberty style, https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty, changed as style_changes says
sources.license: MIT (OpenFreeMap styles), from OSM Liberty and OSM Bright: code under the BSD 3-Clause License, design under CC BY 4.0; styles/LICENSE.md has the terms.
The Maki icons, CC0 1.0; the right arrow from Wikimedia Commons, public domain (styles/LICENSE.md).

sources.origin: OpenFreeMap's glyph ranges of Noto Sans, https://tiles.openfreemap.org/fonts
Noto Sans (notofonts/notofonts.github.io) and Noto Sans JP (notofonts/noto-cjk, Sans2.004)
Natural Earth v5.1.2, Admin 0 – Countries at 1:10m (nvkelso/natural-earth-vector)
Mapterhorn's terrain tiles, https://tiles.mapterhorn.com, as served when the snapshot was built
sources.license: Around San Francisco, USGS 3DEP elevation models, public domain (U.S. Government Work); at low zooms, Copernicus GLO-30 under the Copernicus full, free and open license: © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA, all rights reserved. Mapterhorn lists its sources at https://mapterhorn.com/attribution.

sources.origin: The USGS's earthquake catalog, https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query?format=geojson&starttime=2026-10-01&endtime=2026-11-01&orderby=time-asc, as served when the snapshot was built

style_changes: Removed the raster source `ne2_shaded` (https://tiles.openfreemap.org/natural_earth/ne2sr/{z}/{x}/{y}.png) and the layers that draw it (`natural_earth`): the snapshot holds vector tiles only, and the renderer decides when to rebuild a raster tile's drawables by wall-clock timestamps, so a frame with raster layers could do different work from run to run.

street.description: OpenMapTiles vector tiles of central San Francisco, zooms 0 to 14

world.description: OpenMapTiles vector tiles of the whole world, zooms 0 to 4

cjk.description: OpenMapTiles vector tiles of central Tokyo, zooms 0 to 14, with names in Japanese script

street-mlt.description: OpenMapTiles vector tiles of central San Francisco, zooms 0 to 14

terrain.description: Mapterhorn's terrain tiles of central San Francisco, Terrarium-encoded WebP of 512 pixels, zooms 0 to 12
